title: KATA transparency log tree head
description: Signed Merkle tree head for the append-only log of agreements and revocations. The JWS typ is kata-tree-head+jws. Entries are hash-chained and the root is a binary Merkle root. Status: Concept / Open Design — not production ready.

root.description: Merkle root of the entry hashes. An empty log is the SHA-256 of the empty byte string.

tree_size.description: Number of hash-chained entries under this root.
